name: BlueDocs
description_en:
BlueDocs is a product in the Document management category. Its directory profile covers Optical Character Recognition - OCR, File Type Conversion, File Recovery, e-Signature, Document Retention, Document Indexing, Document Assembly, Document Archiving.

Additional listed capabilities include Compliance Tracking, Collaboration Tools, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: support shared work and communication between participants; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
BlueDocs 属于文档管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括光学字符识别（OCR）、文件格式转换、文件恢复、电子签名、文档保留、文档索引、文档组装、文档归档。

资料还列出合规事项跟踪、协作工具、版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：支持多人共同工作和沟通；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
